About VEIR
Ensuring Power Never Limits Progress
Power demand has become today’s defining constraint on growth. As demand accelerates and legacy infrastructure struggles to keep pace, incremental solutions can no longer deliver the certainty, scale, or speed the future requires. VEIR is the world’s leading company commercializing superconducting power at the platform level, enabling scalable power delivery at industrial scale. Innovation that sets the pace of infrastructure.
